source_name: eKosova national services portal (municipal one-stop-shop business registration pages)
why_relevant: Municipal one-stop-shop pages document the 29 local registration centres and business-type taxonomy, and occasionally publish local business listings — useful for locating vendor operations outside Prishtina.

entity_name: LinkedIn company pages of regional integrators
source_name: LinkedIn company pages of regional integrators (Kosovo/regional entities)
why_relevant: For integrators with thin or stale websites, the LinkedIn page is the live signal: Kosovo job postings, project posts, and named bank client mentions. It is often the only place a Kosovo delivery team is visible for a company headquartered in Belgrade, Skopje, Tirana or Zagreb.

entity_name: LinkedIn company pages of regional integrators
why_relevant: Foreign e-money/payment player with a Kosovo presence; LinkedIn page surfaces hiring, partnership and merchant-acquiring announcements that signal new acceptance channels for non-bank buyers.

Committee/working-group pages name the individuals and member institutions driving shared initiatives (risk, IT, credit registry). Committee composition is a low-noise map of who leads technology decisions across the MFI sector.

entity_name: Dun & Bradstreet business-directory profiles for Kosovo/regional IT subsidiaries
source_name: Shoqata e Sigurimeve të Kosovës (Kosovo Insurance Association) — member insurers
why_relevant: Insurance association covering ~14 licensed insurers (12 non-life, 2 life; mixed domestic/Austrian/Albanian/Slovenian capital). Insurers are an adjacent buyer segment for payment acceptance, policy-administration and bancassurance integrations. NOTE: no independent official association domain was confirmed in this run — this is a placeholder pointer.

source_name: Gjirafa.biz – financial services / money transfer business directory
why_relevant: Kosovo's dominant local business directory; its 'Transfer parash' category enumerates money-transfer and financial-service providers including small operators that never appear in English sources or press. Cheap way to build the long tail of the actor map.

source_name: Ziraat Bank Kosovo — local branch/subsidiary web presence and Ziraat Bankası group reporting
why_relevant: Ziraat's Kosovo unit is the least-documented of the cell's banks; its Turkish parent's group reporting is the more likely disclosure route for any Kosovo IT programme. Recorded as a pointer because no local Ziraat Kosovo domain was confirmed in this run.

source_name: AllEvents — Kosova Finance Forum listing (venue/date archive)
why_relevant: Third-party listing preserving venue (Emerald Hotel), dates and organiser handles for Kosovo finance events after organiser pages rotate; useful for reconstructing an event timeline.

source_name: DevelopmentAid / Devex donor-tender aggregators (Kosovo financial sector)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregators mirror donor tenders and awards across EBRD/WB/EU/USAID and often retain notices after the originating portal deletes them — useful as a backfill and cross-check layer, not as a primary citation.

entity_name: EU Office in Kosovo / EEAS delegation pages
source_name: EU Office in Kosovo / EEAS delegation pages — EU projects and tender announcements
why_relevant: The contracting authority for much Kosovo IPA money; its project and news pages announce financial-sector support (including EBRD/EU blended packages) and point to the corresponding calls.

Long-running mass-market Kosovo portal with a business desk; historically a fast publisher of corporate and banking announcements. Included for completeness of the Albanian-language media set; ownership and editorial line documented by Media Ownership Monitor.

source_name: MoneyMatrix — Payment Solutions in Kosovo (PSP market overview)
why_relevant: Commercial PSP country page listing acquiring/processing options available for Kosovo merchants — useful as a pointer to which international acquirers and gateways actually serve XK, though vendor-marketing biased.

source_name: selltostate.com guide to e-Prokurimi (vendor-side navigation guide)
why_relevant: Commercial bid-intelligence writeup describing how the KRPP/e-Prokurimi portal is structured from a supplier's viewpoint — registration, notice types, where awards appear. Useful as a navigation shortcut, but it is marketing content and its claims must be verified against the portal itself.
